messages:
Maya R: Heads-up — GPU OOM alerts have been flaring every ~30m for the last 6 hours across eu-west-1 clusters. Paging the oncall is noisy, can we revisit paging vs ticketing thresholds?
Kyle H: seeing it too. lots of duplicate alerts from different instances, same root cause (bad job).
Alex T: agree. current alert rule pages on any oom event (severity=critical). we should group and require sustained rate.
Samir: proposed quick wins: 1) require >3 distinct instances in a cluster within 10m to page, 2) for single-instance OOMs, create a ticket only.
Maya R: that sounds reasonable. also we should suppress pages during nightly batch windows (00:00-03:00 UTC) for non-prod clusters.
Kyle H: can we express that in alertmanager routing + prometheus? yes — add matchers to routes and use continue: true for infra team route.
Alex T: here's a starter promql + rule snippet I tested locally:

```
# recording rule to compute per-cluster OOM rate
- record: cluster:gpu_oom_rate:1m
  expr: sum by(cluster) (increase(node_gpu_memory_overcommit_oom_total[1m]))

- alert: ClusterGPUOOMsHigh
  expr: cluster:gpu_oom_rate:1m > 0
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: warning
  annotations:
    summary: "High GPU OOM rate in {{ $labels.cluster }}"
    description: "{{ $value }} OOM events in the last minute"
```

Samir: then alertmanager route: if cluster: matches prod and severity=critical and cluster:gpu_oom_rate:1m > 3 -> page. otherwise -> create ticket.
Kyle H: alternate: keep the original per-instance OOM alert but make it severity=info and don't page. then create a grouping alert that pages when grouped count > 3. fewer changes to existing rules.
Maya R: good idea, smaller blast radius. also we should add a short mute window override for scheduled maintenance windows and our nightly batch. ops-bot can post mute reminders.
ops-bot: scheduled mute created: eu-west-1 nightly-batch (00:00-03:00 UTC) — non-prod routes suppressed.
Alex T: for grouping, set group_by: ['cluster', 'oom_signature'] in alertmanager so jobs with different root causes don't group incorrectly. and bump group_wait to 60s, group_interval 5m.
Samir: add a small noise filter: require alerts to be sustained for 2 evaluation cycles (prometheus retention), i.e., for: 10m helps. also consider using max_over_time on OOM counter to ignore single spikes.
Kyle H: cost note: paging on false positives drives ops cost. paging only on multi-instance events will cut noise and incident hours.
Maya R: action items: Alex will draft the prom rule + alertmanager route change, Kyle will change the per-instance alert to info, Samir will add mute windows, I will update runbook and notify PD escalation policy.
Alex T: I'll open the PR against monitoring infra today and attach the test graphs.
Samir: assign follow-ups in jira: MON-462 (alert tuning), MON-463 (mute windows), MON-464 (runbook update).
pagerduty-bot: New incident policy check: on-call rotation OK for proposed changes.
Maya R: thanks all. let's wait 24h after deploy to verify reduction, then iterate. :thumbsup:
Kyle H: if noise persists we can add a machine-learning anomaly filter later but try rules first.
Alex T: adding a quick dashboard panel suggestion: "OOM events by cluster (last 6h)" with a heatmap and a table of top jobs. will include in PR.
Maya R: perfect. closing thread for now — PR link when ready.
